    When rolling two-handed melee damage, any die rolling 1 or 2 is rerolled once.

    When attacking with a melee weapon you are Proficient with and are wielding in both hands, Attack Rolls take a -5 penalty, but their damage increases by 10.

  • Great Weapon Master: Bonus Attack

    When you land a Critical Hit or kill a target with a melee weapon attack, you can make another melee weapon attack as a  Bonus Action that turn.

    Your attacks deal an extra 1d6⁠⁠Psychic damage - the scars of illithid enslavement run deep.

Involvement

Act One

Baretha is part of a githyanki patrol searching the Wilderness for a powerful weapon. As the sarth in the group, she reports directly to  Kith'rak Voss. As the party approach Baretha and the githyanki patrol near the entrance to the Mountain Pass, they find a group of Flaming Fists demanding they lay down their weapons. The Fists are swiftly defeated in a bath of dragon flames.

Baretha and her squad become hostile to the party if provoked, or if the party fail to talk their way out of Kith'rak Voss' interrogation.

Baretha can be communed with using  Speak with Dead.

  • What is your profession?

          My queen...
  • Do you know where the githyanki crèche is?
    • Baretha
      Mountains...
      • Can I remove an illithid parasite at the crèche?
        • Baretha
          At the crèche... cleansing...
  • Why did you come here?
    • Baretha
      Find... the weapon...

    • Baretha
      All-powerful... Vlaakith's prize...

    • Baretha
      No traitor... loyal to queen...
